title: Red Sand Concrete Powder
description: Adds the ability to use both red sand and normal sand in the crafting recipe for concrete powder.
body:
## What Does this pack do?
This pack makes it so you can use both normal and red sand to craft concrete powder. It supports all the color varients of concrete powder.
## Crafting Example
![Crafting Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e75babac44c2e3151cad2af3a79470e6a78a3c2.png)
## Can I use this in my Modpack/Project?
Yes of course!
## What do I do if I find any bugs/errors?
If you find any bugs or errors feel free to message me on discord @Noiteira.
